messages:
Ravi_CSM: FYI PolarisPay pilot next week needs APAC VPC ingress support. They want header + CIDR matching and a stepped QPS profile for a two-day demo. They also called out renewal pricing as a risk in enablement.
Jon (PolarisPay): Confirmed. Demo window 2026-04-10 08:00 SGT -> 2026-04-11 20:00 SGT. Preferred match: header X-PP-Tenant: polaris-demo and CIDRs 198.51.100.64/28 + 203.0.113.240/29. Request stepped QPS: 50 -> 200 -> 100 over set intervals. Need logs retained 30d and payload redaction for PCI.
Ellen_SE: We can support hybrid header+CIDR matching on apac-vpc-proxy and a stepped policy. Recommend soft_limits with auto-revoke at demo end + 30m buffer. I'll prepare a perf runbook and cost delta for renewal.
Sam_NetOps: Staging ingress manifest now. Planned snippet: ```
match:
  headers:
    X-PP-Tenant: "polaris-demo"
  cidrs: ["198.51.100.64/28","203.0.113.240/29"]
traffic_profile:
  sequence: [50,200,100]
  step_durations: [1800s,14400s,3600s]
  duration_total: 36h
auto_revoke: 2026-04-11T20:30:00+08:00
logging:
  retention_days: 30
  redact_payloads: true
notes: "PolarisPay demo; renewal follow-up; PCI redaction"
```
infra-bot: Change staged by Sam_NetOps on apac-vpc-1. Staging ID: stg-ff21. Scheduled apply: 2026-04-10T07:40:00+08:00.
Sam_NetOps: Applied stg-ff21 -> live. Header+CIDR rules active on apac-vpc-1. Traffic profile enabled. Added alerts: 5xx > 0.2% OR p95 token-latency > 375ms. Reservation request submitted for burst capacity; status: pending-approval.
Jon (PolarisPay): Verified initial handshake looks good. We're seeing connections routed correctly and headers match. Will start the step-up traffic at 08:30 SGT.
Ellen_SE: I'll snapshot perf and cost at T+2h and at midpoint. Ravi, please flag renewal owner; pricing sensitivity noted. I'll include savings recommendations (short TTL caching, batching hints, quantization options).
Ravi_CSM: Assigning renewal owner: @Ravi_CSM for initial outreach; will propose a 2-week pilot credit if perf meets SLA. Adding CRM: PLY-882.
Jon (PolarisPay): One security ask: provide scoped log access to our security team for 14 days and redact PAN-like fields.
Sam_NetOps: Confirmed: logs retained 30d with payload redaction configured; creating scoped temporary viewer link for PolarisPay security with 14d expiry and RBAC.
infra-bot: Reservation update: dedicated-burst request req-482 moved to approved -> allocated for 2026-04-10T08:00-2026-04-11T21:00 SGT.
Sam_NetOps: Reservation allocated and bound to tenant PLY-882. Monitoring dashboards created. If error rate > threshold, I'll escalate to oncall.
Jon (PolarisPay): Traffic has ramped to 200 qps during peak and p95 latency is holding at ~220ms. No 5xx. Team pleased.
Ellen_SE: Good signal. I'll prepare the perf+cost report (tokens, p95, cost per 1k tokens, reservation amortized) and post by EOD tomorrow for the renewal packet.
Ravi_CSM: Thanks everyone 111 capturing this thread in account health and marking demo as 'config applied; monitoring nominal'. Scheduling renewal touch 3 days after demo. If anything degrades, page oncall.
Jon (PolarisPay): Appreciated  we'll follow up after internal review.
Sam_NetOps: Closing config loop: auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-04-11T20:30+08:00. Audit: stg-ff21 -> live recorded.
